title: 兴趣爱好
subtitle: 谈论休闲活动和练习习惯

turns.speaker: nina
turns.text: What is your favorite hobby after work?
turns.translation: 你下班后最喜欢的爱好是什么？

turns.speaker: tom
turns.text: I usually practice the guitar for twenty minutes.
turns.translation: 我通常练习吉他二十分钟。

turns.speaker: nina
turns.text: I collect postcards, but I rarely watch television.
turns.translation: 我收集明信片，但很少看电视。
